title: Council orientation with departmental displays
subtitle: Senior managers introduced; councillors toured eight departmental displays, with no motions or decisions recorded.
overview: The November 29, 2022 meeting was an orientation session for Members of Council, held as a Committee of the Whole meeting. It was not a decision-making meeting, and the minutes record no motions or votes.

The CAO introduced the Senior Management Team and outlined the day. Members moved around displays set up by each department, watched prepared videos and asked questions or raised discussion. Members were asked to spend no more than 30 minutes at each display.

The displays covered the CAO and Human Resources; Public Works and Engineering; Environmental Services (water and wastewater); Planning, Building and Economic Development; Finance, Purchasing and Information Technology; Legislative Services and Municipal Law Enforcement; Parks, Recreation, Community Development, Culture and Tourism; and Fire Services. Members broke for lunch, then resumed their visits until 4:00 pm.
For residents, the session gave councillors background on how municipal services are organized. No policy, spending or service changes came out of it.
